name: lesson-24
description: Bài 24 — cho và nhận hành động: くれます, 〜てあげます, 〜てもらいます, 〜てくれます; người lớn tuổi, chuyển nhà và giúp đỡ.

jobs.subject: first-person view: the reference woman smiling and holding a wrapped present out directly toward the viewer, the gift coming toward the viewer as if being given to them

alt.vi: Cô gái chìa hộp quà về phía tôi.
Người bố đang sửa xe đạp bằng cờ lê.

jobs.subject: seen from behind: the reference woman holding a little girl by the hand, both walking away from the viewer toward a zoo entrance gate with a giraffe visible beyond the fence, blank gate sign

alt.vi: Cô gái nắm tay em gái dắt đi về phía cổng sở thú.

jobs.subject: at the open front door of a home party, the reference male student arriving and walking toward the viewer, leading a shy friend in by the arm, balloons and a party table in the foreground

alt.vi: Chàng trai dẫn bạn đến bữa tiệc, bước vào cửa.

jobs.subject: the reference male student standing beside his parked small car at a train station drop-off, waving goodbye as an older teacher in a suit with a briefcase walks toward the station entrance

alt.vi: Chàng trai đưa thầy giáo ra ga bằng ô tô và vẫy tay tạm biệt.

jobs.subject: the reference woman standing between two people, gesturing with an open palm toward the reference male student as she introduces him to an older businessman, who bows slightly

alt.vi: Cô gái giới thiệu chàng trai với một người đàn ông lớn tuổi.

jobs.subject: the reference woman showing a foreign tourist with a camera around an old Kyoto street, pointing ahead toward a wooden temple gate

alt.vi: Cô gái dẫn khách du lịch tham quan phố cổ Kyoto.

jobs.subject: a friendly shop clerk in an apron explaining to the reference male student how to use a coffee machine, pointing at its plain unlabeled buttons while he listens and nods

alt.vi: Nhân viên giải thích cho chàng trai cách dùng máy pha cà phê.

jobs.subject: a kind elderly man with white hair and glasses, wearing a cardigan, smiling and leaning on a wooden walking cane

alt.vi: Cụ ông tóc bạc chống gậy, mỉm cười hiền hậu.

jobs.subject: a gentle elderly woman with grey hair in a bun, wearing a simple apron over a kimono-style top, smiling with hands folded

alt.vi: Cụ bà tóc bạc búi gọn, mỉm cười hiền từ.

jobs.subject: a small moving truck with its back open, stacked cardboard boxes, a rolled rug, a chair and a potted plant being loaded in front of an apartment building, blank truck sides, compact composition with plenty of empty space around it

alt.vi: Xe tải nhỏ chở thùng các-tông và đồ đạc khi chuyển nhà.

jobs.subject: a compact assortment of sweets: a small open box of chocolates, a few wrapped candies, cookies and a Japanese daifuku on a small plate

alt.vi: Hộp sô-cô-la, kẹo, bánh quy và bánh daifuku.

jobs.subject: the reference male student with a suitcase being warmly welcomed at the doorway of a Japanese house by a smiling host family: a mother, a father and a child

alt.vi: Gia đình Nhật vui vẻ đón chàng trai đến ở homestay.

jobs.subject: moving day in a bright new apartment: the male student carries a large cardboard box through the doorway to help, while the woman unpacks dishes from an open box beside a low table; stacked boxes, a potted plant and a lamp waiting to be placed; all boxes plain and unlabeled.

alt.vi: Chàng trai bê thùng đồ giúp cô gái chuyển đến căn hộ mới.
